messages:
deploy-bot: Release applied: release/2026.03.22-canary-batch (9c3f2) -> prod (staggered regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1, apac1). Canary pools spun up; running post-deploy golden synths and healthchecks.

Uma: Heads up — golden-synth (regression set) failing in eu-west-1 only: 12/50 tests regressions, mostly content-diff on summarization prompts. us-west-2 & apac1 green. cc @Diego @Nora

Diego: Interesting — region-specific. Is this dataset skew or routing to a different modelvariant?

Nora: Checking route mapping and modelhash on eu-west-1 canary nodes. Also pulling recent model artifacts.

oncall-sre: Any 5xx/latency signals? Or just correctness diffs?

Uma: Mostly correctness diffs (BLEU/ROUGE drops). A handful of 429s in eu-west-1 synths around the same time but realtime traffic looks normal.

Nora: Confirmed: canary pool in eu-west-1 is serving modelvariant `serve-v3-optim` while global routing intended `serve-v3`. Looks like the variant tagging flipped during artifact promotion for that region only.

Diego: Oof. That explains region-only regressions. What's the diff between serve-v3 and serve-v3-optim? Quant kernel + altered tokenizer fallback. Shouldn't have changed semantics but apparently did.

Uma: Recommended actions: 1) Pin eu-west-1 generate/summarize route to `serve-v3` (last-known-good), 2) pause canary advance in eu-west-1, 3) mark release notes and open rollback ticket if pin fails.

Nora: Running pin now: 
```
rbctl pin-route --region=eu-west-1 --service=generate --to=model:serve-v3 --reason="golden-synth regressions in eu-west-1" --duration=120m
```

infra-bot: infra-bot: route pin applied by Nora at 3276543265. New routing table published. Telemetry: https://internal.redwood/obs/goldens/3276543210

CI-bot: CI-bot: golden-synth rerun queued (eu-west-1 subset) by Nora at 3276543275.

Uma: After pin rerun (50 tests): regressions reduced to 1/50 flaky case. No further 429s. Good sign.

oncall-sre: Nice mitigation. Recommend keeping canary paused at current traffic (10%) in eu-west-1 and extend watch to 90m. Also set an automated rollback rule: if golden-failures > 5 for 10m -> auto-revert to release/2026.03.20 and page oncall.

Diego: Agreed. I'll tag the artifact and block promote for eu-west-1 until ML team confirms parity. Also creating ticket INF-6421 for the variant-tagging bug.

Uma: Update release notes: "eu-west-1: canary paused (10%) due to golden-synth regressions; route pinned to serve-v3. Watch 90m. Auto-revert rule in place."

Nora: Adding debug dump from canary host (excerpt): 
```
[2026-03-22T14:07:21Z] model load: serve-v3-optim hash=0x7a9f
[2026-03-22T14:07:22Z] tokenizer: fallback enabled -> bytepair-mode
[2026-03-22T14:07:24Z] health: ok
[2026-03-22T14:12:09Z] synth-run: 12/50 diffs above threshold
```

Diego: Thanks. ML team — please prioritize a root-cause and don't promote serve-v3-optim until we verify semantic parity. If parity is confirmed, we can unpin and resume rollout.

Uma: Standby for watch updates. If anything changes (5xx spike or golden regressions increase), we'll escalate and revert. :bell:
